items.title: Chink Martin Interview, 1966-10-19
items.q: I might have known him, but I just can't recollect the name, you see?

ctx.x: What about Watsky? Did you ever know him? A violin player named Watsky? King, Watsky, got everybody to know him. He may have been uptown or something. No, I don't know. I think maybe Bud Lloyd Cannon told me about him or something. I'm not sure what I've been talking about. You know where I'm telling him.

Well, Dick, I might have... You see, this is the idea. I might have known him, but I just can't recollect the name, you see? I can't place the name. Sure, well, you never remember everybody's name. Because I've met so many and played with so many, I can't think of their names. You know what I mean?
Was Max Fink hot like Oscar Marco or was he more straight?
